text.text: One move frees the waterfront: the port and North Harbour leave for Thilafushi. Four wings then reconnect Malé to the world, the ocean, its past and its future. An amenity core of kiosks, a school and park, a sports centre and shops ties them together.
The parti: the port leaves, and four wings open Malé to the world, the ocean, its past and its future.
Wing zone north, east, south and west
Wing connection to the world, the ocean, the past and the future
Amenity core node everyday needs between wings
Vista / breeze cut through the reclaimed grid to the sea
